title: Studio empty states carry the primary action (Validations, Hooks, Actions, Automations, Access)
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `d4bc81eab`, 2026-10-15, in a writable package with one object and nothing else:

- Validations, Hooks and Actions tabs (`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` and its two siblings): a list card about 150 px wide with a "New" button and "No validation rules yet…", beside a card that fills the rest of the column reading "Select a rule on the left, or click New to create one" (`engine.studio.rules.pick`); Hooks says "Select a hook to edit it", Actions "Select an action to edit its properties".
- Automations pillar with no flow: the rail says "No automations yet — click New to start" (`engine.studio.auto.none`) while the control is a "+" icon with no visible word; the canvas card reads "Select an automation" (`engine.studio.auto.pick`); the aside reads "Click a node on the canvas, and its configuration appears here". Three columns, all empty.
- Access pillar with no permission set: the content reads "Create a permission set to start configuring" (`engine.studio.access.emptyMain`) with no control; the "+" is in the rail header.

## Target

1. Each empty surface is one centered block in the content column: the pillar's icon, one sentence, a primary button that opens the same create dialog as the rail's "+" (New validation rule / New hook / New action / New automation / New permission set).
2. The aside and the right card show nothing while there is nothing to select; the "Select…" sentences retire.
3. The rail's empty sentence names the control it points at, or the control is a labelled button inside the rail's empty state.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (Automations and Access empty branches), `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`, `ObjectHooksPanel.tsx`, the actions panel beside them, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (retired and new keys in every locale), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: each empty state's button opens the create dialog (the same handler as the rail's "+").
2. Screenshots of the five empty states at 1280 px, light and dark.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- Lands after #12454 (its claim covers the `AutomationsPillar` region); the Access branch coordinates with #12456 if that card is claimed first.
- Existing `data-testid`s stay.

Blocked-by: #12454

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12446
